description:
# Check: upstream input.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/input.test.ts

## Subject
Single-line text input component with kill ring and undo/redo (subset of editor behaviors).

## Upstream test count (approx)
60

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- submits value including backslash on Enter
- inserts backslash as regular character
- no overflow with wide CJK/fullwidth text at cursor start/middle/end position
- keeps cursor visible when horizontally scrolling wide text
- Ctrl+W saves deleted text to kill ring and Ctrl+Y yanks it
- Ctrl+U saves deleted text to kill ring
- Ctrl+K saves deleted text to kill ring
- Ctrl+Y no-op when kill ring is empty
- Alt+Y cycles through kill ring after Ctrl+Y
- Alt+Y no-op if not preceded by yank
- Alt+Y no-op if kill ring has one entry
- consecutive Ctrl+W accumulates into one kill ring entry
- non-delete actions break kill accumulation
- non-yank actions break Alt+Y chain
- kill ring rotation persists after cycling
- backward deletions prepend, forward deletions append during accumulation
- Alt+D deletes word forward and saves to kill ring
- handles yank in middle of text
- handles yank-pop in middle of text
- undo no-op when stack empty
- coalesces consecutive word characters into one undo unit
- undoes spaces one at a time
- undoes backspace
- undoes forward delete
- undoes Ctrl+W (delete word backward)
- undoes Ctrl+K (delete to line end)
- undoes Ctrl+U (delete to line start)
- undoes yank
- undoes paste atomically
- undoes Alt+D (delete word forward)
- cursor movement starts new undo unit

## Upstream dependencies
Input from ../src/components/input.js; visibleWidth

## Upstream notes
Single-line variant of Editor. Kill ring and undo tests are comprehensive. Wide character handling critical for rendering.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/input.test.ts (33 tests, ~60 assertions)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (1144 lines, ~130 tests)

Architectural note: upstream `Input` is single-line; our Elixir `Input` has absorbed upstream `Editor` features (multiline, shift+enter, up/down nav, page nav, history, scroll indicators, grapheme-aware wrap, paddingX). This is a deliberate scope expansion — the audit compares against input.test.ts only; editor.test.ts is opi-q5k.5.

## MAPPED (essentially complete)

| Upstream area | Elixir coverage |
|---|---|
| submits value including backslash on Enter | "submits value including backslash on Enter" |
| inserts backslash as regular character | "inserts backslash as regular character" |
| Kill ring: Ctrl+W+Ctrl+Y | "Ctrl+W saves deleted text to kill ring and Ctrl+Y yanks it" |
| Kill ring: Ctrl+U | "Ctrl+U saves deleted text to kill ring" |
| Kill ring: Ctrl+K | "Ctrl+K saves deleted text to kill ring" |
| Kill ring: Ctrl+Y empty | "Ctrl+Y does nothing when kill ring is empty" |
| Kill ring: Alt+Y cycles | "Alt+Y cycles through kill ring after Ctrl+Y" |
| Kill ring: Alt+Y no preceding yank | "Alt+Y does nothing if not preceded by yank" |
| Kill ring: Alt+Y single entry | "Alt+Y does nothing if kill ring has one entry" |
| Kill ring: consecutive Ctrl+W accumulates | "consecutive Ctrl+W accumulates into one kill ring entry" |
| Kill ring: non-delete breaks accumulation | "non-delete actions break kill accumulation" |
| Kill ring: non-yank breaks Alt+Y chain | "non-yank actions break Alt+Y chain" |
| Kill ring: rotation persists | "kill ring rotation persists after cycling" |
| Kill ring: backward prepend/forward append | "backward deletions prepend, forward deletions append during accumulation" |
| Kill ring: Alt+D | "Alt+D deletes word forward and saves to kill ring" |
| Kill ring: yank middle | "handles yank in middle of text" |
| Kill ring: yank-pop middle | "handles yank-pop in middle of text" |
| Undo: empty stack no-op | "does nothing when undo stack is empty" |
| Undo: word coalescence | "coalesces consecutive word characters into one undo unit" |
| Undo: spaces one at a time | "undoes spaces one at a time" |
| Undo: backspace | "undoes backspace" |
| Undo: forward delete | "undoes forward delete" |
| Undo: Ctrl+W | "undoes Ctrl+W (delete word backward)" |
| Undo: Ctrl+K | "undoes Ctrl+K (delete to line end)" |
| Undo: Ctrl+U | "undoes Ctrl+U (delete to line start)" |
| Undo: yank | "undoes yank" |
| Undo: paste atomically | "undoes paste atomically" |
| Undo: Alt+D | "undoes Alt+D (delete word forward)" |
| Undo: cursor movement new unit | "cursor movement starts new undo unit" |

## UNMAPPED (minor)

1. **CJK overflow sweep**: upstream "does not overflow with wide CJK and fullwidth text" iterates 4 CJK samples × 3 cursor positions (start/middle/end) × width 93, asserting `visibleWidth(rendered_line) <= width` for every combination. Our CJK wrap tests cover specific boundary cases but not the full sweep with the overflow-safety invariant at arbitrary cursor positions.

2. **Cursor-visible-after-horizontal-scroll with wide text**: upstream: width 20, 14 Hangul graphemes (각 = 2 cols), Ctrl+A + 5× right, assert `visibleWidth(line) <= 20`. Our scroll_offset tests verify positive offset but don't assert the post-scroll rendered line's visible_width against terminal width for wide content.

## N/A / EXTRA

Elixir adds: multiline editing, shift+enter, up/down vertical navigation, page up/page down, scroll indicators, history (9 tests), cursor_rc for multiline, paddingX (7 tests), grapheme-aware wrap (6 tests), multiline kill operations, backspace at line boundary, paste with `\r\n` normalization. All strictly beyond upstream scope; retain.

## Action

Small compliance ticket to add the two overflow-safety sweeps. Otherwise clean.
